Trn2 UltraServer: 64 Trainium2 chips across 4 servers, 6 TiB HBM, NeuronLink
Trn3 UltraServer: up to 144 Trainium3 chips, 20.7 TB HBM3e, 706 TB/s
Trn3 racks pack over 2× the chips of Trn2 racks. Power per rack isn't published.
